title: How many writes are unavoidable?
hook: A carried key can displace a whole cycle of misplaced keys.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Place distinct items along permutation cycles to minimize array writes.

misconception: Every comparison sort needs repeated swaps and two writes per swap.
objective: Place distinct items along permutation cycles to minimize array writes.

claims.text: A carried value jumps to its final rank, displacing the next value in the cycle. Already correct positions are skipped; this distinct-key trace counts writes rather than counting adjacent swaps.
